AI assistant for a property agency: features, costs and implementation

How VIA AI and VIA Properties advise buyers, match agency listings and send conversation history to an agent. Features, limits, prices and launch preparation.

An AI assistant can handle an agency's initial consultation, clarify a request and match properties from a connected database. Visitors explain what they need, ask follow-up questions and submit an enquiry during the conversation. RESET offers VIA AI for websites and VIA Properties for Telegram. Both use a shared approach to requests, with interfaces and connections adapted to each channel. Here we cover use cases, data preparation, launch costs and the boundary between an assistant's advice and an agent's responsibilities.

01

What an AI assistant does for a property agency

Many initial questions repeat: what is available, what fits the budget, whether a property is renovated and what alternatives exist. Staff need to clarify requirements and consult the database. An assistant can guide this first stage and show listings that match the available data. Clients can adjust criteria, revisit options and ask about features. Once there is specific interest, the agent receives an enquiry with context already collected.

This is particularly useful outside working hours or across languages. VIA can receive requests around the clock while the service and connected infrastructure are available. It adapts the conversation to the user's language; the scenarios needed for each market are checked during implementation. The team keeps its usual working hours and follows up after receiving the enquiry, already knowing the client's interests and viewed properties.

02

VIA AI on a website and VIA Properties in Telegram

VIA AI embeds into a website so visitors can ask questions while browsing. Someone arriving from search or an ad can review an offer and speak through the widget. VIA Properties opens as a Telegram Mini App, combining listings, an assistant and enquiry submission. Its link can appear in social posts, advertisements and property selections. We choose the format according to where the agency meets its audience and which enquiry journey suits clients.

03

How a voice AI consultant works on a website

Imagine a buyer from Sweden visiting a Spanish agency's website on Sunday evening. They are interested in apartments in Punta Prima and want to understand the options and budget. Through VIA AI, they can type or speak, specify rental or purchase and give their criteria. The assistant searches the connected database and displays suitable properties. If one attracts interest, the configured journey helps send an enquiry to an agent.

With the appropriate integration, staff receive the contact details provided, conversation history and a request summary. On Monday, they can continue discussing a particular apartment, area or budget, knowing what the person asked and viewed. This reduces repeated information gathering and helps prepare for the conversation. The example illustrates a possible journey; the actual data and destination are agreed during setup.

We have implemented VIA AI for ESTYLE SPAIN, Costa Vieja and NIVELLUX, a renovation and construction company in Valencia. Property consultations use listings and search criteria; related businesses need scenarios tailored to their services and common questions. See the interface in the VIA AI case study and the renovation website in NIVELLUX. Assessing a widget alongside visitor traffic and landing-page content is especially useful. We explore their relationship in our article on Google Ads for real estate.

04

Property matching in Telegram

The journey can begin with a link to a property or agency advertisement. Users open VIA Properties, browse listings and ask for alternatives. For example, they can request two-room apartments in Arcadia by voice, then specify budget and renovation requirements. The assistant searches the connected database using those criteria. When the client wants to discuss a viewing, they submit an enquiry through the interface and the agent receives the configured notification.

We have implemented this format for Helping, Delmar and Domstar in Odesa. A small team can use it for a catalogue, consultations and enquiries. Extended setup includes CRM, customised scenarios and the option to message clients. The scope must fit the agency's work: complex deal tracking, roles and external integrations are discussed separately. See VIA Properties. Our article on choosing a real estate CRM can help when deciding between a lightweight tool and a larger system.

Telegram can reduce repeated data entry, but available information depends on how the app opens and what the user does. A name, identifier and username, when present, may support the configured authentication process. A phone number must be requested separately with user involvement; it is not automatically received when the app opens. Messaging also depends on interaction with the bot and granted permissions. These details are covered in the Telegram Mini Apps documentation and shape enquiry and follow-up configuration.

05

Where properties, prices and specifications come from

VIA connects to the agency's database, including through an XML property feed. Stable identifiers, current prices, transaction type, location and specifications matter. Complete fields make matching rules clearer. If renovation or room data is missing, the assistant has no reliable source for that value. Database preparation is therefore discussed before dialogue configuration.

Price and availability updates depend on the source system and agreed synchronisation. At launch, check how changes appear and how withdrawn listings disappear. If nothing matches, the appropriate response is to explain this and offer revised criteria or staff assistance. Missing details should be referred to an agent. This keeps answers grounded in the agency's actual data.

06

When an estate agent takes over

The assistant supports exploration and initial information gathering. Further commitments require a responsible employee. Legal questions, special terms, discounts and viewing confirmations must follow explicitly agreed rules. “Can I view it on Thursday?” does not itself create a confirmed appointment. Confirmation needs an available slot and the appropriate integration or an agent's decision. During implementation, we define what the assistant can say independently and when it should offer human contact.

From the first question to agent handover
StepAssistant actionWhat the agency receives
Initial enquiryIdentifies the language and clarifies intentThe client’s objective
ClarificationCollects search criteriaBudget, location and requirements
MatchingShows options from the connected databaseInterest in specific properties
Contact or viewing requestOffers the configured handover methodAn enquiry for an agent
Follow-upSends available context through the configured integrationConversation history and summary

Staff need the complete available context: properties of interest, criteria, questions and the contact method provided. We separately agree notifications and how a person can join when needed. In the CRM or working tool, each enquiry needs an owner and a next step. Otherwise, even a useful conversation can go nowhere. See our article on automating property enquiries for notifications, tasks and processing oversight.

07

What a website or Telegram assistant costs

Basic VIA Properties setup starts at $200, covering the supplied database and consultations within an agreed scenario. Extended setup costs $500 and includes CRM, scenario configuration and client messaging capability. VIA AI has a one-time setup fee of $400 for the basic package or $800 for the extended package with custom dialogue flows. For VIA AI, AI and voice service usage is billed separately from setup and the monthly payment. Under RESET's current terms, there is no limit on the number of conversations.

Database preparation, XML feed creation or source-data corrections are quoted after reviewing the materials. Any paid third-party systems are also considered in the estimate.

08

Preparation and implementation time

Launch requires a property database, agency information, access to the chosen channel and an agreed destination for enquiries. Together we define languages, client questions, search criteria and the limits of independent answers. We then connect data, configure the interface and arrange handover. A basic Telegram scenario can launch from three days; a website VIA AI connection usually takes around a week. These estimates assume prepared data and access. Data preparation and additional integrations affect timing.

Before launch, test typical conversations across languages and search conditions, including no matches, missing information and viewing requests. Check that contacts and history reach the agreed working system. Voice tests should cover neighbourhood names, numbers and corrections. This reveals data limitations and lets the team adjust the journey before sending the main traffic.

09

How to assess value after launch

Start with the share of visitors who begin a conversation, view properties and submit an enquiry. Then assess request completeness, staff response time and subsequent progress. Message volume alone says little about commercial value. When someone finds suitable properties, leaves contact details and continues with an agent, examine that journey alongside its traffic source. Comparisons between periods should account for changes in advertising, offers and availability.

VIA is worth considering where recurring questions, current data and a clear follow-up process already exist. Users may be agencies, independent agents, developers or related businesses with their own scenarios. For websites and Telegram, the starting point is the same: what people ask before enquiring and what information helps them move forward. We begin there, choose an interface and connect it to staff workflows. The result is an initial consultation tool whose value can be assessed through real enquiries and their follow-up.
